title: Pushing for health equity through structural competency and implicit bias education: A qualitative evaluation of a racial/ethnic health disparities elective course for pharmacy learners
reason: Qualitative thematic analysis of weekly reflections from nine pharmacy students in an elective; LMS discussion threads are mentioned as assessment components but no measure is related to success or a construct.

extraction.n_quote: This study used a qualitative descriptive design with a sample of nine second- and third-year pharmacy students.
extraction.population: second- and third-year pharmacy students, University of Cincinnati
extraction.notes: Reflections are activity products but are analysed only thematically, not linked to success or a construct.
